0022600149.text: The Atlanta Hawks (3-3, 2nd in the Southeast, 0.5 games back, 7th in the East) visit the New Orleans Pelicans (1-4, 5th in the Southwest, 4 games back, 14th in the West) in the Hawks' seventh game of the season. Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture) are out for Atlanta, while New Orleans is without Yves Missi (knee bruise) and has Dejounte Murray (personal) and Jordan Poole (ankle) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Hawks won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 117-100 in Atlanta on January 7, 2026.
